description: PEACH is an online calculation service and Python package led by Ouranos for probabilistic climate-hazard assessment. It combines climate indicators from more than 500 CMIP6 simulations, bias-adjusted against Canadian station observations, and weights models and emissions scenarios to estimate hazard likelihoods. Users select a Canadian area, indicator and scenario assumptions; outputs include probability distributions and time series through a prototype web interface or OGC API Processes backend. Geographic coverage of the documented data is Canada, and the time horizon follows the selected climate projections. Apache-2.0 source is public, with a separately linked climate-data repository. A limitation is that the README labels this release v0.1.0 and a prototype; weighting and bias adjustment do not eliminate model uncertainty. PEACH can provide probabilistic weather hazards for roads, power grids and water assets. The catalogue's data-era5-reanalysis is a separate historical reanalysis product. No climate ensemble or service output was downloaded.
